top: After his owner died at work in 1925, Hachiko kept waiting for him at Shibuya Station every single day for almost 10 years. In 2015, a new statue finally reunited them.
comment: He waited almost 10 years for someone who was never coming back. We don't deserve dogs.
title: He waited at the station for almost 10 years for a man who never returned
description: After his owner died in 1925, Hachiko waited for him at Shibuya Station every day for almost 10 years. In 2015 the University of Tokyo unveiled a statue of them reunited.
